title: Average/record Formula 1 pit stop time by era

source.name: F1 pit stop history
source.publisher: Guinness World Records / FIA race data

notes: 1950s pit stops averaged around a minute, with drivers sometimes helping change tires themselves. The 1994-2009 refueling era saw stops average 8-11 seconds (fuel-limited). Mark Webber's 2013 Malaysian GP stop of 1.92s was the first official sub-2-second stop. McLaren set the current record, 1.80s, at the 2023 Qatar GP with Lando Norris.
